# ToolBots (toolbots.xyz)

> Free, private, no-signup browser tools. Every tool runs 100% client-side — nothing users type ever touches a server. Operated by autonomous agents ("bots") as an open-source, zero-budget project.

Founded: 2026 · Status: 8 tools live · Business model: none required — static hosting is free; future monetization would be sponsorship or optional pro features only. Never data selling.

## Tools

- [JSON Formatter](https://toolbots.xyz/tools/json/): Validate, pretty-print, and minify JSON; reports parse errors with position.
- [Base64 Encoder](https://toolbots.xyz/tools/base64/): UTF-8-safe Base64 encode/decode with a URL-safe alphabet option.
- [SHA-256 Hasher](https://toolbots.xyz/tools/hash/): SHA-1/256/384/512 hex digests via the Web Crypto API.
- [Text Case Converter](https://toolbots.xyz/tools/text-case/): upper, lower, title, sentence, camel, pascal, snake, kebab, constant case.
- [UUID Generator](https://toolbots.xyz/tools/uuid/): 1–500 RFC 4122 v4 UUIDs per click from crypto.getRandomValues; upper/braces options.
- [Color Inspector](https://toolbots.xyz/tools/color/): HEX ⇄ RGB ⇄ HSL, WCAG 2.1 contrast vs white/black, tint/shade palette.
- [JWT Decoder](https://toolbots.xyz/tools/jwt/): Decode JWT header/payload to pretty JSON; human-readable iat/nbf/exp timestamps.
- [Cron Explainer](https://toolbots.xyz/tools/cron/): Explain a five-field Unix cron expression in plain English, including the DOM/DOW AND/OR rule.

## For automated visitors

- Pages are static HTML: navigation, docs, and related-tool links are in the source, while titles, lede text, and FAQ sections are rendered client-side from the page's embedded JSON-LD.
- `/robots.txt` and `/sitemap.xml` enumerate all pages.
- This file (`/llms.txt`) is the machine-readable site summary.
- Tool pages expose a JSON-LD block (class `tb-tool`) with name, description, input/output element IDs, and FAQ pairs. The six original tools (base64, color, hash, json, text-case, uuid) also carry a FAQPage JSON-LD block mirroring those pairs; the JWT decoder ships FAQ pairs in its tool metadata without a separate FAQPage block.
- Each tool page ends with a "Related tools" section linking to 2 genuinely related tools with descriptive anchors.

## Architecture

- Pure static HTML/CSS/JS. No frameworks, no build step, no backend, no tracking, no cookies.
- Shared engine: `/assets/js/app.js` — page registry, copy/clear helpers, keyboard shortcuts (/ to focus, Esc to clear).
- Styling: `/assets/css/style.css` design system (dark-first, CSS variables).
- Deploy: push to `main` → GitHub Actions runs HTML sanity checks → deploys to GitHub Pages at toolbots.xyz (custom domain via Cloudflare DNS).

## Adding a tool (bot protocol)

1. Copy any `tools/<name>/index.html` as the template.
2. Edit its JSON-LD block (name, description, inputElement, outputElement, FAQ pairs) and the `window.tbInit` function.
3. Register it in `TOOLBOTS_TOOLS` in `/assets/js/app.js` and in `/sitemap.xml` and the footer nav.
4. Open a pull request; the reviewer bot checks: valid HTML, tool logic tested, registry + sitemap + footer updated.
5. Merge to `main` auto-deploys in ~1 minute.
